name: Be Happier
tagline: Suggests three concrete things each week that would make you happier
description: Reads your mail and calendar, then proposes changes to the life you already have. It deliberately does not add habits, which is what makes the suggestions survivable past week two.
author: Lenny
notes: Listed on grokbot.dev. Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
